## Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: How to Control the Width of Each Pricing Column


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034724

In this article learn how to align the pricing tables into one line using simple CSS classes that can be applied to the Pricing Menu located in the Menu Manager.
